release_notes: Added 5 new native Android Home Screen Widgets (Total Balance, Monthly Income & Expense, Individual Wallet Balance, Monthly Expense Summary, Quick Add Transaction) with light/dark theme support and Settings configuration.
Added Cash Withdrawal from Bank, Card, MFS, PSP, Savings, and Other wallets into Cash wallets with optional separate fee expense tracking.
Added Debit Card / Credit Card type selector, dynamic Card Label auto-update, TAP (Trust And Pay) in MFS, and a dedicated BD PSP wallet category (10 local PSP providers).
Added custom accent color picker for Cash, PSP, Bank, Savings, and Other wallets.
Added full in-place Edit support for Loans & Lendings and fixed Start Date display on cards and detail dialogs.
Disabled future months in Financial Reports month selector while keeping current and past months active.
Refined dialog/sheet field spacing (-20%) and transaction amount field height (-20%) for cleaner ergonomics.
